name: cmk-lang
information_for_contributors: cmk-lang TextMate grammar.  SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH is the token -> scope taxonomy in
compose.mk/docs/theme/js/prism-cmk.js (the same table that drives the docs Prism
grammar).  cmk extends GNU Makefile: shared constructs (targets, define, variables,
recipes) plus cmk-lang sugar (pragmas, @# docstrings, ## doc-comments, import/declare
callforms, embed fences, integral/flow glyphs).  Keep scopes in sync with that table.

assignment.comment: Variable assignment `name := value` (also `?= += != = ::=`).  Scopes the LHS name + the assign operator; the value runs on so an inner `${..}`/string still highlights.  An `export`/`override`/`private` modifier keeps its keyword scope (capture 1) so it is not silently swallowed.  Optional leading whitespace so cmk's 2-space-indented block assignments (`  ${self}.run ?= run`) are caught too.  A `:=`/`?=` never collides with the rule head (`#target` guards `(?!=)`).  MIRRORS the Prism `cmk-assignment` token.

recipe.comment: Tab-indented recipe body -- embed `source.shell` so genuine shell recipe lines get real shell highlighting, WITHOUT shadowing the cmk token rules that already colored recipe content (strings, banana, capture, make-refs, operators).  A `begin`/`while` region shadows the top-level patterns, so every cmk token include that used to apply to a recipe line is re-listed FIRST; `source.shell` is only the final fallback for the plain-shell leftovers (bare commands like `echo`/`for`).  NOTE: anchored on a literal TAB, matching the host makefile grammar; author-form 2-space cmk recipe bodies are a separate follow-up.
recipe.name: meta.scope.recipe.cmk

divider.comment: decorative section-divider run -- 4+ U+2591 light-shade chars (░░░░…), optionally after a `#`/`##`.  Placed BEFORE #comments so it wins over the comment/doc-comment rules.  Split into captures so the `#` prefix stays a divider comment while the ░ run itself takes the bright-red `constant.character.shade.cmk` scope.  MIRRORS the Prism `cmk-divider` token (colors via the package.json textMateRules).

shade.comment: the U+2591 light-shade glyph (░) on its own -- decorative section boxes and figlet-style banner art use it heavily.  Given a dedicated scope so it renders bright red via the package.json textMateRule.  The #divider rule (listed first) already carves the ░ out of `##░░░` comment lines; this catches ░ everywhere else.  MIRROR: keep a matching `cmk-shade` token in the Prism grammar.
shade.name: constant.character.shade.cmk

compose-key.comment: Docker-compose service/build/deploy keys and their values, in inlined compose yaml, in triple-string bodies, and in callform kwargs alike.  Listed AFTER `#target` so a column-0 makefile rule head (`build:`) stays a target, and BEFORE `#callform-kv` wherever kwargs are parsed so the pair is claimed whole.  The value runs to end of line, except that a further word carrying its own `=` ends it (so one kwarg cannot swallow its siblings) and so does a banana closer.  MIRRORS the Prism `cmk-compose-pair` token (keep the two key lists in sync).

callform-kv.comment:
key=value kwargs.  The value may be QUOTED (and then contain spaces, e.g.
 `targets='ul.* underload'`) -- match the whole quoted run so a space doesn't split it
 and leave a dangling quote that eats the rest of the file.

decorator.comment: @name(args) binding/annotation decorator at COLUMN 0, e.g. `@args.from_json(shape color=blue name=default)` or bare `@fault.guarded`.  The `^@` anchor keeps a recipe `\t@echo` (tab-indented) untouched.  MIRRORS the Prism `cmk-decorator` token (keep scopes in sync).

receiver.comment: receiver STREAM-form name -- a dotted name immediately before a `[` stream bracket (e.g. `inbox.emit["""..."""]`), the receiver being piped into.  MIRRORS the Prism `cmk-receiver-name` token (keep scopes in sync).
receiver.name: entity.name.function.cmk

decl-head.comment: cmk declaration head -- a KIND-introducing keyword + the name it mints: `class Cook`, `constructor jqlang`, `code demo_one(| .. |)`, `strategy portfolio(| .. |)`, bodyless `container ubuntu`.  Keyword set = the `cmk` prelude declaration keywords (compose.mk `cmk.prelude.names`) plus the `strategy`/`mixin` companions; `code` is the code-object minter (`polyglot` is kept as its back-compat alias).  Requires whitespace + a name after the keyword, so a target `class:` or an assignment `class = x` is untouched.  Capture 1 is the keyword (`storage.type`), capture 2 the minted KIND/type name (`entity.name.type`).  Capture 3 is an OPTIONAL metaclass callform `(k=v ..)` -- CONSUMED here (not the banana opener `(|`, which the `|`-excluded char class stops before) and re-tokenized as kwargs via #callform-kv, so a metaclass head like `code demo_two(img=elixir:otp-27-alpine entrypoint=elixir)(| .. |)` highlights its kwargs instead of leaving `(img=.. entrypoint=..)` as bare text.  The trailing lookahead requires the name (past the optional callform) be immediately followed by a banana opener or EOL -- so a KIND+instance head like `container job hello(|`, where a 2nd bareword sits between the keyword-name and the banana, is NOT mis-claimed as a declaration; it falls to #banana-instance.  MIRRORS the Prism `cmk-decl-head` token.

banana-instance.comment: module-level named-banana INSTANCE head -- a KIND (one or more dotted words, the space-form of a dotted constructor: `container job` = `container.job`) followed by the instance NAME, then a banana opener: `container job hello(| .. |)`, `multistage image greeter(| .. |)`, `jqlang git_status(| .. |)`.  Capture 1 (the KIND words) is `entity.name.type.cmk`; capture 2 (the final NAME) is `entity.name.function.cmk`.  Requires 2+ words so a bare `portfolio(|` stays a plain #banana-name; included AFTER #decl-head so a `constructor container.job[|` DECLARATION is claimed there first (its banana/EOL lookahead lets this multi-word instance form fall through).  This is what makes the keyword-led (`container ..`) and plain (`multistage ..`) instance heads scope IDENTICALLY instead of one mis-firing as a declaration.  MIRRORS the Prism `cmk-banana-instance` token.

banana-name.comment: the NAME immediately before a banana opener `(|` / `[|` / `{|` -- the thing a named banana block constructs (`portfolio(| .. |)`, `git_status(| .. |)`), including the name in a user-KIND head (`jqlang git_status(| .. |)`, whose KIND is not a fixed keyword).  A `decl-head` keyword line wins over this by leftmost-match, so `strategy portfolio(|` keeps its keyword+type scopes.  Same `entity.name.function.cmk` as the stream receiver.
banana-name.name: entity.name.function.cmk

callform-name.comment: namespaced callform name -- a known cmk namespace root + dotted members immediately before a `(` or `/` (e.g. `log.target(..)`, `cmk.log.io(..)`, `io.foo/bar`).  The commonest kind of 2-space recipe line in cmk, otherwise unscoped.  Restricted to the Prism `cmk-fxn` namespace set so it never repaints an ordinary dotted shell/word token; INCLUDED AFTER `#target` so a pattern-rule head like `mk.foo/%:` stays a target rather than being grabbed by the `/` lookahead.  MIRRORS the Prism `cmk-fxn` token (entity.name.function.namespaced.cmk).
callform-name.name: entity.name.function.namespaced.cmk

cmk-import.comment: cmk-lang namespace directives (MIRROR: prism-cmk.js `cmk-import`).  Col-0 forms, differing by INTENT: `import <ns>[, ..]` USE (assert-resolves), `open <ns>[, ..] [except A B]` MODIFY (load-if-exists, drop names), `import <src>[, ..] as <ns>[, ..] [kw=v..]` load source(s) + route namespace(s), `from <mod> import <*|names> [except A B]` Pythonic selective bind of a module's members.

patterns.comment: `from <mod> import <*|names> [except A B]` -- Pythonic selective bind of a core module's prelude members (twin of `open`).
`open <ns>[, <ns2>] [except A B]` -- MODIFY intent (own scope so themes can distinguish it from `import`); optional `except` list drops named members (twin of `from .. import * except`).

cmk-import-kwargs.comment: trailing `key=value` kwargs on an `import .. as ..` directive.

cmk-include.comment: `include` / `-include` / `sinclude` directive -- split from #keywords so it can render brighter than ordinary keywords (MIRROR: prism-cmk.js `keyword-include`)
cmk-include.name: keyword.control.import.include.cmk

target.comment: Rule head: NAME(s) up to the `:`/`::` (never `:=`) + prerequisites.  Capture 3 = the deps, run to EOL or an inline `;`-recipe (left for the recipe grammar), so they can be weighted separately (oblique via the package.json textMateRule).  MIRRORS the Prism `prereq` token (entity.name.function.target.prereq.cmk).  The leading `(?![^:=\r\n]*[(\[{]\|)` negative-lookahead REFUSES the match when a banana opener (`(|`/`[|`/`{|`) precedes the colon -- a real target/pattern-rule head never contains one, so this stops a KIND-prefixed named-banana head like `jqlang wrap(|   { result: . } |)` from being mis-read as a target up to the `:` inside the (jq) body (#banana-name only preempts col-0 heads; a KIND prefix pushes the name off column 0).

patterns.comment: Pythonic DOCSTRING -- a triple-quote group that OPENS a line (col-0 = module `__doc__`, tab-indented first recipe line = target docstring).  The `^[ \t]*` anchor excludes an inline triple-string VALUE (which follows `=`/`(`/a command mid-line), so a docstring can render muted+italic (see package.json textMateRule).  MUST precede the generic triple-string below.  MIRRORS the Prism `cmk-docstring-triple` token.
patterns.name: string.quoted.docstring.cmk

patterns.comment: GNU Make builtin function library -- `$(shell ..)`, `$(wildcard ..)`, `$(patsubst ..)` etc.  The `$(` opener + the function word scope; arguments fall through to the surrounding patterns (so an inner `${..}` still highlights).  MIRRORS the Prism stock-makefile `function` token (support.function.builtin.cmk).

`${mk.def.read}/hello_world` -- a var-ref used like a path (a compose.mk idiom): the `${..}` head splits from the `/tail`.  Placed BEFORE the plain var-ref below so the head is not consumed alone.  MIRRORS the Prism `pseudo-path` token (entity.name.path.tail.cmk).

embed-fence.name: punctuation.definition.embed.cmk
embed-fence.comment: U+2AFB triple-solidus and U+1F7B9 as the Dockerfile / config embed fences

cmk-sugar.comment: integral U+2A16; flow arrows U+21D0 U+1409 U+1F844 U+1F846 U+2B26 U+2B25 U+174F; sigil U+25B0; bracket-pair U+27E6 U+27E7; chevron-pair U+22D9 U+22D8 (both promoted to their own scope -- MIRRORS Prism cmk-bracket/cmk-chevron)

handle.comment: the `&NAME` HANDLE bind LHS -- the `&` marks a DEFERRED bind (`&bound <- ..`): store the callable but do NOT run it.  Capture 1 (the `&` sigil) is an operator; capture 2 (the name) is a variable, so the name isn't left as plain text and the `&` isn't mis-tagged as the shell `&&`/background operator.  A trailing `<-` lookahead scopes it to the bind site ONLY, so a YAML anchor (`alice: &base`) inside an inlined compose file is left alone.  Included BEFORE #operators so its bare `&` doesn't win first.  MIRRORS the Prism `cmk-handle` token.

capture.comment: the `<-` capture operator (rendered EXTREMELY bright/bold/oblique via the package.json textMateRule).  Lookbehind `(?<![<$])` keeps `<<-` heredocs / `$<` auto-vars clear.  MIRRORS the Prism `cmk-capture` token.
capture.name: keyword.operator.capture.cmk
